_step150: the shot leaves on a tap's release (planning step 137): each tap goes down on `tick` and comes up on `release`, the next tick unless it says later
_about: 4-24 (wave 4a, round 1; a dark level, no knight). door_lift_1786 bars the way to the door and rises only while button_1785
(178, 108) is held, which lies in a pocket over double_block_plat_1778 that nothing the player can reach sees: so the stone
rolling_stone_1781, which sits on single_block_plat_1780 in a nook, is carried there by a portal pair, and its weight holds the
button. The pocket's portal is placed FIRST because the port's entries are edges (Portals.cpp, the sweep): a stone already inside a
portal when its partner opens is not taken, so the second portal has to open on the stone. The player walks right over
button_1784 (304, 220), which raises door_lift_1782 (up from tick 28, and held up only while the button is pressed), and on to
x 360, where door_lift_1786 stops him. Tap 1 (down on 62, the shot leaves on 63) at (188, 72): it passes under the raised door,
over the corner of the platform (the log says 'after the head-height retry') and opens in the pocket on tick 124. It must not
pass within 24 units of light_off_1689 (222, 52), which spends any shot that does: from x 360 this one passes 36 units clear, and
a tap at (208, 70) passes 23 and lights the torch with it (the first draft aimed at (205, 60), lit it and opened nothing). He
then walks left the whole way to the crystal at (16, 208) (taken on 202; the third crystal is what makes the medal gold, the other
two lie on the way) and taps the stone from x 29 (down on 212, up 213) at (60, 60): the ray meets the stone's skin and the portal
opens 10 units inside it at (60.2, 58.8) on tick 252, with the stone in it, and the stone goes through on that tick, drops onto
double_block_plat_1778 and presses button_1785 (253), and door_lift_1786 is up long before he is back at x 360 (the right walk
from 214). Won on tick 387, medal 3 (2 portals = the golden score, all 3 crystals), 2 shots, aim drift 0.015 px. No achievement.
Each tap moved alone with the rest held (test_mp_routes --only on a copy): tap 1's tick 42 to 82, tap 2's tick 186 to 234; tap
1's point is a diagonal band across the pocket (at y 70 x 160 to 202, at y 82 x 184 to 208, at x 196 y 64 to 88: its two edges are
the platform's corner and the torch); tap 2's point x 44 to 76 at y 28 to 60 (a portal takes the stone when its centre is within 44 units of the
stone's, the stone's 30 and the portal's 14). Unmeasured on the original: that a stone already inside a portal when its partner opens is left where it is (the
original looks for an object in a portal each frame, step 156's deviation 5); the route does not lean on it either way.
